summary: Develop performance audit plans, test efficiency evidence, and report findings. Explore the five-day course and request a training proposal.
lede: Performance auditing helps internal auditors, performance auditors, and assurance professionals assess whether resources and processes achieve intended results. Training covers setting audit questions and criteria, evaluating economy, efficiency, and effectiveness, and checking evidence and performance indicators. Practical exercises include process mapping, spreadsheet analysis, tracing root causes, and drafting evidence-linked findings and recommendations.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who plan, conduct, supervise, or use performance audits and efficiency assessments in operational, programme, and assurance settings.
modules: Effectiveness Testing with OECD DAC Criteria
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with internal audit, programme monitoring, operational reporting, or performance indicators is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access; Power BI is optional for the visualization exercise. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted document review are introduced at conceptual or operational-awareness level, not taught as technical implementation.
